title: Title and Lien Department Rule: Releasing the Lien on a Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract
content:
**Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract — lien release.**

1. The lien can be released only when the contract status is paid in full.
2. **Funds hold.** When the funds that brought the balance to zero were a personal check or an ACH debit, the lien may be released no earlier than the product's hold period in business days after the balance reached zero. Business days are Monday through Friday excluding US federal holidays, counted from the first business day after the paid-in-full date, and release on the last day of the hold is permitted. Payoffs by cashier's check, wire, dealer, lender or insurer remittance carry no hold.
3. **Release method.** Where the lien is electronic, it is released electronically to the title state within the product's electronic release period in business days; where the lien is on paper, the title is signed off and mailed within the product's paper title period in business days.
4. **Recipient.** The recipient follows how the contract was paid off: a refinance-lender payoff goes to the new lienholder, a dealer trade-in payoff to the dealer, an insurance total-loss payoff to the insurer, and every other payoff to the customer.
5. **Alternate address.** A paper title may be mailed to an address other than the address on file only after the customer has completed a signed alternate-address title release request.
6. Once the release is completed the title status is updated and the account is closed.

## The hold as a time test

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Clock starts from | the paid-in-full date recorded on the contract |
| Counting | business days, day one being the first business day after the paid-in-full date |
| Comparison | release not earlier than the last day of the hold |
| Boundary | release on the last day of the hold is permitted |

*Boundary cases (abstract):* with a hold of H business days, release on business day H is permitted; release on business day H less 1 is not.

## Recipient table

| Payoff by | Lien release or title goes to |
|---|---|
| Refinance lender | the new lienholder |
| Dealer trade-in | the dealer |
| Insurance total loss | the insurer |
| Any other payoff | the customer |
